method.workload: One verified16MiB file, one exact128KiB prelude each direction, twelve pipelined length-framed64B echoes every250ms after1s bulk lead
method.request_ttfb: frame send start to first echo header byte; excludes SOCKS setup
method.request_body: frame send start to complete64B echo validation
method.scheduled_latency: intended dispatch to first echo header or complete echo; includes local queue
method.p95: nearest rank across successful messages;12 samples gives maximum
method.medians: median of two arm p95s/goodputs, not pooled populationp95
method.quota: actual store counter request estimates including warmup and8s tail; exactcleanup commands separate
method.control: Same frozen binary actual default, or exact clean main binary with identical source kit settings; experiments cleared
method.route: google_front_pinned, www.google.com TLS front; approved isolated secondary account
method.exit_probe: Equal enabled for same-binary comparisons; absent in both arms of clean-main comparisons because main lacks command
method.quota_limit: 100000 estimated units/rolling60s plus per-arm100000/cumulative350000 guard; stop any API error/backoff; counters omit opaque HTTP2 retry attempts
method.host: No coordinated agent builds/tests during final arms; ordinary desktop background uncontrolled
method.small_payload: Actual64B framed persistent echoes; unused legacy HTTP-template size is omitted
method.percentile_note: Median of two arm p95s. With12messages, nearest-rank p95 equals the maximum; never a population quantile.
method.role_snapshots: Per-role files may include shutdown/cancellation counters after summary snapshot; arm comparison uses harness warmup+tail summary. All are local request estimates, not wire billing.
